name: Google Ads
one_liner: Programmatic API for managing Google Ads accounts, campaigns, budgets, assets and reporting.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 via Application Default Credentials (user credentials or service account) for the MCP server. Developer tokens are being sunset on September 9, 2026; access level is tied to the Cloud project that owns the OAuth client or service account.
access_notes: Enabling the API gives Test access automatically. Production access requires applying for Explorer (2,880 ops/day), Basic (15,000 ops/day) or Standard (unlimited) access; Standard needs a manual compliance audit, typically about 10 business days. Cost is not stated in the cached pages.

buildability.rationale: Documented public REST API with self-serve test access and OAuth2. Production use needs an access-level application, and Standard requires manual audit. Developer token sunset in Sept 2026 changes auth setup.

identity.quote: The Google Ads API is a programmatic interface for managing Google Ads accounts and campaigns, suitable for large or complex setups.

auth.quote: Application Default Credentials (OAuth 2.0 user credentials or service account) for local stdio
Google sunset developer tokens (GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN) on September 9, 2026.
The Google Cloud project that owns your OAuth client or service account determines your API access level.

access.quote: apply for Explorer access on the Google Ads API Overview page to access production accounts.
The Standard access level is only granted to developers who require unlimited Google Ads API operations, such as large companies or tools that serve many users.
involves a detailed manual audit of your application.

sandbox.quote: After you've enabled Google Ads API, your Google Cloud project is granted Test access.
Enabling the API grants Test access for testing read and mutate workflows against test accounts.

api_surface.quote: Java, .NET, PHP, Python, Ruby, Perl, Code samples, REST interface
Regardless of the access level, all API operations are subject to system rate limits

mcp.quote: The Google Ads MCP server provides a standardized bridge to the Google Ads API.
Read and partial mutate (asset creation, video uploads, and label management with propose-and-confirm validation, or configurable read-only mode)

buildability.quote: The Basic access level allows your Google Cloud project to execute up to 15,000 operations per day.

needs_human_reason: Pricing and exact review timelines are not stated in the cached pages.
